title: Semi-similar Prandtl Flows near a Stagnation Point: Dynamical Selection and Nonlinear Stability
summary: This paper studies time-dependent semi-similar Prandtl flows with outer flow $U(x)=x^m$, where $m\geq1$. The normal coordinate is scaled by the local boundary-layer thickness, and time by the associated diffusion scale. Every time-monotone solution in the Oleinik class extends globally in time. The Falkner--Skan boundary layer globally attracts every such unsteady semi-similar profile. The convergence rate is exponential for $m=1$ and algebraic for $m>1$.
